steps.content:
Based on those two pages, **it doesn't matter — they're identical.**

Both listings are for the exact same product with the exact same offer terms:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones - Graphite**

|  | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Fulfillment** | Sold and shipped by Brackmoor Sound | Sold and shipped by Ottervale Audio |
| **Availability / Shipping** | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days. | In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days. |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping. Refund to original payment method. |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited warranty. | 1-year limited warranty. |
| **Specs / In the box** | over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency mode, up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C (10 min = 5 hours), Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable | Same - over-ear, closed back, wireless, ANC with transparency mode, up to 40 hours with ANC on, USB-C (10 min = 5 hours), Bluetooth 5.3 with two-device pairing, 254g, headphones, carry case, USB-C cable, 3.5mm cable |

Why I can't recommend one over the other:

1.  Same price
2.  Same shipping speed and cost
3.  Same return policy
4.  Same warranty
5.  Same customer rating
6.  Same specifications and what's included

Buy from either one. If you have shopped with one before, or have a preference for their customer service, use that as a tie-breaker — there's nothing in these two listings themselves that makes one better.
